title: REVERSE (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,REVERSE(Name) AS RevName FROM Sample.Person ORDER BY RevName
SELECT REVERSE(+007.10) AS RevNum, REVERSE('+007.10') AS RevNumStr
SELECT CAST(1.1 AS DOUBLE) AS DoubleNumber, REVERSE(CAST(1.1 AS DOUBLE)) AS ReverseDouble
SELECT FavoriteColors,REVERSE(FavoriteColors) AS RevColors FROM Sample.Person
SELECT DOB,%INTERNAL(DOB) AS IntDOB,REVERSE(DOB) AS RevDOB FROM Sample.Person
